note: Status lines of the kind AI coding agents actually produce, used only to measure how much of that language the dictionary can explain. 'jargon' is marked by hand: the words a capable person with no coding background would trip on. source 'build-session' means the line came from an agent working on this repository; 'representative' means it was written to stand in for a pattern seen repeatedly; 'contributed' means a builder outside this project supplied it from their own agent's output, published as supplied. Names invented inside someone's own project - a feature codename, an internal module - are left unmarked, because no general dictionary could explain a word that exists in one repository. Nothing here contains credentials, customer data, or anyone's source code.
